profile.name: Nadine De Klerk
profile.writeup:
Nadine de Klerk is a versatile right-handed batting all-rounder for South Africa. Known for her 'never-say-die' attitude and ability to perform under extreme pressure, she has earned the nickname 'de Clutch' from fans and teammates alike. After transitioning to cricket from field hockey and javelin at age 15, she rose quickly through the ranks to become a mainstay in the Proteas' national setup.

De Klerk is considered a genuine three-dimensional player who contributes significantly in all departments. Originally known for raw power hitting, she has matured into a calculated finisher. She also acts as a vital partnership-breaker during the middle overs. Her bowling is characterized by accuracy and clever variations.

Nadine has been a central figure in South Africa's recent era of success, including three consecutive World Cup final appearances. Her standout tournament was the 2025 ODI World Cup in India, where she amassed 327 runs. A career-defining moment was her unbeaten 84 off 54 balls against India, which included 5 sixes and secured a thrilling three-wicket victory.

De Klerk has played franchise cricket all over the globe, and she is also a two-time champion of the Women's Premier League, winning the title with Royal Challengers Bengaluru in 2024 and then with Mumbai Indians in 2025. For the 2026 season, she has been re-united with the RCB franchise and will be expected to play a major role, especially given the fact that Ellyse Perry has pulled out of the tournament due to personal reasons.
